paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. Length: prefill length + generation length. Bsz: batch size. KV mem.: GPU memory usage (GB) of the KV cache. Thr.: throughput (token/s) : S_r ratio ablation study.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio as a function of Recent Sequence Ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick labels at intervals of 20%. The y-axis is split into two scales: the left y-axis is labeled "Perplexity" and has a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.5, and the right y-axis is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 40% to 100%. A blue solid line with circular markers represents "GPU Mem. Ratio," which starts at approximately 42% at x=0% and increases to approximately 97% at x=100%. A red dashed line with circular markers represents "Perplexity," which starts at approximately 4.25 at x = 0% and decreases to approximately 4.35 at x =100%. A red dashed line represents “Full Cache PPL", which remains approximately constant at 4.35 across the range of the x-axis. A blue solid line represents “Full Cache GPU Mem.” which starts at approximately 43% at x=0% and increases to approximately 65% at x=100%.
